PresentationMode__SavedCameraScenes.PresentationMode__SavedCameraScenes__Des: Optional per-project saved camera scenes for Presentation Mode. Camera position and orbit target values are integer millimetres; rotations and FOV use the same format as Camera__DefaultPosition. Scenes are split into named Groups; Scene Order restarts at 1 within each group. A scene with PresentationMode__Scene__LayoutEditorOnly set true is available to the Layout Editor and the Dev menu but is hidden from the viewer carousel; the key is omitted when false.
